@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: When you speak English, it is important to remember which nouns are c______e and which ones are not.
= countable
~詞義 countable（adj.）可數的
~原文 When you speak English, it is important to remember which nouns are countable and which ones are not.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The knife had cut deep into my f______h, and the wound wouldn't stop the bleeding.
= flesh
~詞義 flesh（n.）肉
~原文 The knife had cut deep into my flesh, and the wound wouldn't stop the bleeding.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Whoever visits this city should go to the famous f______n, toss a coin into it, and make a wish.
= fountain
~詞義 fountain（n.）噴泉
~原文 Whoever visits this city should go to the famous fountain, toss a coin into it, and make a wish.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: You must remember to wear a h______t when you ride a motorcycle.
= helmet
~詞義 helmet（n.）安全帽
~原文 You must remember to wear a helmet when you ride a motorcycle.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It is very cold these days, so we turn on the heater for w______h every night.
= warmth
~詞義 warmth（n.）溫暖
~原文 It is very cold these days, so we turn on the heater for warmth every night.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: My uncle has traveled to five of the world's ______.
A: recorders
B: youngsters
C: continents
D: bubbles
= C
~詞義 continent（n.）大陸
~原文 My uncle has traveled to five of the world's continents.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The manager of each branch of the coffee shop reports to a ______ manager.
A: teenage
B: merry
C: vital
D: regional
= D
~詞義 regional（adj.）區域性的
~原文 The manager of each branch of the coffee shop reports to a regional manager.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: You should eat more fruit and vegetables. There are a lot of ______ in them.
A: ministers
B: vitamins
C: gangsters
D: recorders
= B
~詞義 vitamin（n.）維他命
~原文 You should eat more fruit and vegetables. There are a lot of vitamins in them.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The car hit a truck and ______ off the road, and the driver was badly injured in the accident.
A: spun
B: towed
C: erased
D: grinned
= A
~詞義 spin（v.）旋轉
~原文 The car hit a truck and spun off the road, and the driver was badly injured in the accident.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Melissa gave several ______ about wanting a present, hoping her husband would get the message and buy a necklace for her.
A: hints
B: bubbles
C: traders
D: violets
= A
~詞義 hint（n.）暗示
~原文 Melissa gave several hints about wanting a present, hoping her husband would get the message and buy a necklace for her.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: splash
B: youthful
C: record
D: region
E: trail
F: pity

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The largest castle in the ______ used to stand here. Unfortunately, it was destroyed by a bomb during the First World War.
= D
~詞義 region（n.）區域
~原文 The largest castle in the region used to stand here. Unfortunately, it was destroyed by a bomb during the First World War.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The class expressed deep ______ for their classmate, who had unexpectedly lost a close family member.
= F
~詞義 pity（n.）同情
~原文 The class expressed deep pity for their classmate, who had unexpectedly lost a close family member.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Some people keep a diary to ______ their personal thoughts and experiences every day.
= C
~詞義 record（v.）紀錄
~原文 Some people keep a diary to record their personal thoughts and experiences every day.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Despite Mr. Smith's age, he still carried a ______ spirit that made him popular among his students.
= B
~詞義 youthful（adj.）年輕的
~原文 Despite Mr. Smith's age, he still carried a youthful spirit that made him popular among his students.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The hunter followed the ______ of the deer carefully and silently, hoping to catch it.
= E
~詞義 trail（n.）足跡;痕跡
~原文 The hunter followed the trail of the deer carefully and silently, hoping to catch it.

@bank

C: limb

F: merry

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Chinese New Year's Eve is a ______ time for my family.
= F
~詞義 merry（adj.）快樂的
~原文 Chinese New Year's Eve is a merry time for my family.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Dave's parents gave him complete freedom during his ______ years.
= B
~詞義 teenage（adj.）青少年的
~原文 Dave's parents gave him complete freedom during his teenage years.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The doctor examined the patient's swollen ______ carefully, checking for signs of a broken bone or torn muscle.
= C
~詞義 limb（n.）肢體
~原文 The doctor examined the patient's swollen limb carefully, checking for signs of a broken bone or torn muscle.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: My car was ______ away because I had parked it on the red line.
= D
~詞義 tow（v.）拖
~原文 My car was towed away because I had parked it on the red line.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: As long as you place the ______ of the machine into a socket, it should work.
= E
~詞義 plug（n.）插頭
~原文 As long as you place the plug of the machine into a socket, it should work.
